eng_blog.notes: The blog includes technical/AI-related material, but the engineering-stack article is by Janan Dave and the AI systems article is by Head of Product Brett Dooies; the evidence does not show at least two build-focused posts authored by engineers as required.

claygent-argon-B.reasoning: Verifiable is a healthcare provider-credentialing and monitoring company. I used its first-party pages for product, customer, security, model-provider, documentation, and Salesforce evidence; the current official job board for hiring; dated press material for launch and funding; and company/funding profiles for founding, headcount, and headquarters. Where the exact test requires evidence that was not available (leadership changes), I left the status unknown rather than infer a negative.

public_docs.notes: The public API documentation portal has multiple sections, including getting started, authentication, provider, facility, monitoring, and credentialing references.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified round was the July 2023 Series B, before the 18-month window beginning 2025-05-09.

founded_year.notes: Y Combinator lists Verifiable as founded in 2019; some sources describe its later 2020 launch.

last_funding.notes: The July 2023 Series B announcement reports $27 million; the funding profile identifies this as the latest round.

launched_6mo.notes: The newest launch-type announcement in the readable press history is CredAgent on 2026-02-26, before the 2026-05-09 to 2026-11-09 window; newer blog items are not product launches.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation shown has no pricing link, and the /pricing URL returns a bare redirect/error page rather than public plans or prices.

employee_band.notes: The cited profile reports an official employee count of 138, which falls in this band.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current Lever board lists three roles and none is an SDR, BDR, sales/business-development representative, or account executive.

model_provider.notes: The subprocessor list says OpenAI supports credentialing data extraction, normalization, reasoning, and workflow assistance; Anthropic Claude supports code generation, evaluation, testing, and workflow assistance.

named_customers.notes: These names appear in the company homepage customer logo area.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live Lever board lists Customer Success Manager, Enterprise Customer Success Manager, and Solutions Engineer; none has a qualifying AI/ML/data-science title.

compliance_certs.notes: The security page names the AICPA SOC 2 trust-service principles and an annual independent audit, though it does not explicitly state a formal certification.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Verifiable describes a native Salesforce application and lists Salesforce as a platform used to process and manage provider-verification information.

product_one_liner.value: Verifiable automates healthcare provider credentialing and ongoing provider-network monitoring for provider organizations and health and dental plans through software, APIs, and credentialing services.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No dated C-level or VP-level joining or departure within the 12 months before 2026-11-09 was verified; available leadership information is insufficient to establish a negative.
